description: Sets up a part of a shop's domain made only for its marketing email (for example news.example.com) so Overvio can send from it through Amazon SES: the ownership record, the DKIM key, the custom MAIL FROM MX and SPF, DMARC and the link tracking CNAME. Every record goes under the host the template is applied to; the root domain is never changed.
variableDescription: %verify_token%: the ownership token Overvio made for the domain (hex). %dkim_id%: the DKIM selector after its fixed ovr prefix (8 hex). %dkim_public_key%: the base64 public half of the DKIM key Overvio made for the domain. %dmarc_token%: the domain's DMARC report token (32 hex).
